pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-polygonal dark regions with softened edge gradients due to image haze. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank and decreases in spatial area toward the posterior and ventral regions. Edges exhibit low angularity with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pathways forming a primarily trivalent and tetravalent nodal graph. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the central flank with high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder line against the background.
